_comment: Rulings on calendar findings. One entry per key; `why` is mandatory in spirit — an entry with no reason cannot be told apart from sweeping something under the rug. An optional `until` (YYYY-MM-DD) expires the ack and re-alerts, which is how 'revisit when the venue is announced' becomes a mechanism instead of a promise. Add entries with: python scripts/watch_calendar_sources.py --ack-all --why "..."

season:white rabbit ccq.why: Already on the calendar as 'Disney Lorcana: CCQ Essen 2026' (Sep 19, White Rabbit Community Game Store, Essen). Same event — the community page names it after the store, Ravensburger's own page names it after the event, and the two share no words, so no name matcher will ever reconcile them.
season:white rabbit ccq.name: White Rabbit CCQ

season:lore league senigallia ccq.why: Already on the calendar as 'Utopica Fantasy Festival CCQ' (Sep 19, Senigallia). Ravensburger's page names the festival, the community page names the league running it.
season:lore league senigallia ccq.name: Lore League Senigallia CCQ

season:rarehunter ccq.why: Already on the calendar as 'Iconic Tour CCQ' (Oct 3-4). RareHunter is the organising shop; Iconic Tour is the event, which is what Ravensburger lists it as. NOTE the unresolved venue conflict on that row: Ravensburger says Klagenfurt am Woerthersee, the shop's ticket page says Schwechat near Vienna.
season:rarehunter ccq.name: RareHunter CCQ
